sections.label: Research, Innovation and Enterprise funding
sections.summary: The Government will set aside $19 billion for the Research, Innovation and Enterprise 2020 Plan for 2016-2020 and focus on capturing value from R&D.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: The Government will sustain our commitment to research, innovation and enterprise.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: We will set aside $19 billion for the Research, Innovation and Enterprise (RIE) 2020 Plan for 2016-2020.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: We will continue to invest in research but sharpen our focus on how we create and capture value from our R&D investments.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: We will grow our capabilities in research translation, innovation and facilitating startups, so that scientific breakthroughs improve our lives.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: We will support industries to get better at investing in new ideas and facilitate the flow-through of researchers into industries.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: Our investments will be focused in domains where Singapore has a strong competitive edge and where research and innovation can be applied to our economic and social needs.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: We will work with our companies to grow industry R&D capabilities and nurture innovative enterprises, to strengthen economic competitiveness and create value and good jobs for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: We will build stronger linkages across the value chain in our research, innovation and enterprise ecosystem – scientists, technologists, innovators, entrepreneurs, venture funds, MNCs and homegrown companies – to bring technology from our laboratories into our industries and grow stronger industry clusters.

sections.label: Industry postgraduate research training
sections.summary: Under SkillsFuture, industries will be involved in postgraduate research training through new programmes such as Engineering Doctorates and an expanded Industrial Postgraduate Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: In line with SkillsFuture, we will involve industries in providing postgraduate research training for Singaporeans through new programmes, such as Engineering Doctorates, and by expanding EDB's 	Page: 62 Industrial Postgraduate Programme.
